source_note: Full NNLEM 2021 (398 molecules) + WHO SEARO/MoHP OPD protocols. Reference only — verify with licensed clinician before clinical use.

drugs.rag_text: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) first-line antipyretic and analgesic in Nepal OPD. Preferred over NSAIDs in pregnancy and peptic ulcer. Overdose >150mg/kg risks hepatotoxicity; N-acetylcysteine if within 8h. Nepal OPD: Acute bronchitis; Acute pain ladder; Burns; Dengue fever; Fever without focus child; Hepatitis E pregnancy; Low back pain; Measles.
Ibuprofen NSAID for inflammatory pain. Avoid in dengue (bleeding risk). Use shortest duration. Monitor GI and renal function. Nepal OPD: Gout acute; Migraine; Osteoarthritis; Renal colic.

Amoxicillin first-line beta-lactam for community infections in Nepal. High resistance in typhoid — do not use alone for enteric fever. Check penicillin allergy history. Nepal OPD: Acute otitis media; Acute pharyngitis; Antibiotic stewardship; Dental abscess; H pylori; H pylori clarithromycin; Leptospirosis; Pneumonia child IMCI.

Co-amoxiclav for beta-lactamase producing organisms. First-line for cat/dog bites in Nepal. GI side effects common; take with food. Nepal OPD: Acute otitis media; Animal bite non-snake; Cellulitis; Community pneumonia adult; Diabetic foot infection; Sinusitis bacterial.

contraindications: QT prolongation with other QT drugs
drugs.adult_dose: 500mg OD x3 days or 1g single dose
drugs.rag_text: Azithromycin useful for atypical pneumonia and as alternative in typhoid where fluoroquinolones contraindicated. QT prolongation risk — avoid with fluoroquinolones. Nepal OPD: Community pneumonia adult; STI syndromic; Trachoma; Typhoid cefixime; Typhoid fever.
Ciprofloxacin historically used for typhoid in South Asia but rising resistance. Reserve for culture-guided therapy. Avoid in children and pregnancy. Nepal OPD: Shigella dysentery.

Ceftriaxone third-gen cephalosporin for severe infections and enteric fever. IM painful — use lidocaine diluent. Do not mix with calcium in neonates. Nepal OPD: Pelvic inflammatory disease; STI syndromic; Typhoid cefixime; Typhoid fever.

Metronidazole for amoebic dysentery and giardiasis common in Nepal. Disulfiram-like reaction with alcohol. Metallic taste common. Nepal OPD: Dental abscess; Diabetic foot infection; Giardiasis; H pylori; Pelvic inflammatory disease; Shigella dysentery.
Albendazole mass drug administration common in Nepal school programs. Single dose for roundworm, hookworm, whipworm. Nepal OPD: Soil-transmitted helminths.
Ondansetron 5-HT3 antagonist for vomiting in gastroenteritis and pregnancy hyperemesis. Constipation common. Use lowest effective dose.

ORS cornerstone of diarrhea management in Nepal. Low osmolarity WHO formula. Zinc co-therapy recommended for children. Nepal OPD: Acute diarrhea child; Acute malnutrition child; Adult dehydration; Cholera; Heat exhaustion; Travelers diarrhea adult.

drugs.adult_dose: Not routine in adults for diarrhea
drugs.rag_text: Zinc reduces diarrhea duration in Nepali children per WHO IMCI. Give with ORS for 10–14 days. Nepal OPD: Acute diarrhea child.

Metformin first-line T2DM in Nepal urban clinics. Hold before iodinated contrast. GI upset — start low, take with meals. B12 deficiency with long use. Nepal OPD: B12 deficiency; Insulin therapy T2DM; Type 2 diabetes.
Glibenclamide cheap sulfonylurea common in rural Nepal. High hypoglycemia risk especially in elderly and renal impairment. Educate on hypoglycemia symptoms. Nepal OPD: Type 2 diabetes.
NPH intermediate insulin. Cold chain challenge in Nepal hills — patient education on storage below 25°C. Rotate injection sites. Nepal OPD: Insulin initiation; Insulin therapy T2DM.
Amlodipine long-acting CCB first-line HTN in Nepal. Peripheral edema common. Once daily adherence friendly. Nepal OPD: Hypertension; Hypertension ACE inhibitor; Pre-eclampsia; Resistant hypertension.

Enalapril ACE inhibitor. Contraindicated in pregnancy — teratogenic. Monitor potassium and creatinine. Dry cough 10%. Nepal OPD: Chronic kidney disease HTN; Heart failure edema; Heart failure reduced EF; Hypertension; Hypertension ACE inhibitor.
Losartan ARB alternative when ACE-I cough intolerable. Safer in pregnancy than ACE-I but still avoid in pregnancy. Nepal OPD: Chronic kidney disease HTN; Hypertension.
Atenolol cardioselective beta-blocker. Avoid in asthma. Do not stop abruptly. Less preferred than amlodipine as first-line HTN. Nepal OPD: Atrial fibrillation anticoag.
Furosemide loop diuretic for fluid overload. Monitor K+, Mg2+, renal function. Take morning to avoid nocturia. Nepal OPD: Heart failure edema; Heart failure reduced EF.
Low-dose aspirin antiplatelet. Avoid in dengue thrombocytopenia. GI bleed risk — consider PPI if high risk. Nepal OPD: ACS antiplatelet.
Clopidogrel P2Y12 inhibitor. Combined with aspirin in ACS (dual antiplatelet). Bleeding risk. Generic available in Nepal. Nepal OPD: ACS antiplatelet.

Warfarin requires INR monitoring — challenging in rural Nepal. Many drug and food interactions. Vitamin K in green leafy vegetables affects dose. Nepal OPD: Atrial fibrillation; Atrial fibrillation anticoag.

drugs.adult_dose: 2 puffs PRN; neb 2.5–5mg q20min x3 in acute
drugs.rag_text: Salbutamol short-acting beta-agonist rescue inhaler. Teach spacer technique. Tremor and tachycardia common. Household air pollution worsens asthma in Kathmandu valley. Nepal OPD: Asthma; Asthma montelukast; COPD bronchodilator; COPD exacerbation.
ICS controller therapy for asthma. Rinse mouth after use. Not for acute attacks. Combine with salbutamol rescue. Nepal OPD: Asthma.
Rifampicin cornerstone of Nepal DOTS TB regimen. Orange body fluids. Hepatotoxic — monitor LFTs. Potent CYP inducer — many interactions. Nepal OPD: Drug-resistant TB refer; Leprosy; Pulmonary TB.
Isoniazid first-line anti-TB. Give pyridoxine 25mg OD to prevent neuropathy. Monitor for hepatitis symptoms. Nepal OPD: Pulmonary TB.

contraindications: Children too young for color vision testing
drugs.rag_text: Ethambutol anti-TB. Baseline and monthly visual acuity and color vision. Retrobulbar neuritis reversible if caught early.
Pyrazinamide intensive phase 2 months. Hyperuricemia common. Hepatotoxicity — part of triple hepatotoxic regimen with INH and RIF.
ACT first-line for falciparum malaria in Nepal Terai endemic districts. Take with fatty food. Confirm diagnosis with RDT before treatment. Nepal OPD: Malaria falciparum.
Chloroquine for vivax in Nepal. P. falciparum largely resistant — use ACT instead. Combine with primaquine for radical cure of vivax. Nepal OPD: P vivax radical cure.

Omeprazole PPI for dyspepsia and ulcer common in Nepal. Long-term use — magnesium and B12 deficiency risk. Part of H. pylori eradication. Nepal OPD: GERD dyspepsia; H pylori; H pylori clarithromycin; Peptic ulcer bleeding risk.
Ranitidine H2 blocker. Many brands withdrawn globally due to NDMA — verify supply quality in Nepal. PPI often preferred.
Prednisolone systemic steroid. Short courses for asthma exacerbation. Do not use alone for undiagnosed TB. Taper if >7–14 days. Nepal OPD: COPD bronchodilator; COPD exacerbation.
Dexamethasone potent long-acting steroid. Single dose for croup. Meningitis adjunct reduces mortality. Trekking medicine for HACE. Nepal OPD: Altitude illness.
Phenobarbitone still used in rural Nepal epilepsy due to cost. Sedation and cognitive effects. Teratogenic — folate supplementation in pregnancy. Nepal OPD: Epilepsy.
Carbamazepine enzyme inducer — interacts with OCP and warfarin. HLA-B*1502 screening in Asian populations for SJS risk. Nepal OPD: Epilepsy valproate.

drugs.adult_dose: 200mg OD–BD between meals with vitamin C
drugs.rag_text: Iron deficiency anemia highly prevalent in Nepali women. Black stools normal. Constipation common. Take 2h apart from antacids. Nepal OPD: Antenatal care; Iron deficiency anemia; Postnatal care.

Folic acid essential in pregnancy neural tube defect prevention. Nepal ANC protocol includes iron-folic acid. Mask B12 deficiency if used alone. Nepal OPD: Antenatal care; Iron deficiency anemia; Postnatal care.
Calcium supplementation in pregnancy and osteoporosis. Take with vitamin D in Nepal high latitude/low sun exposure populations. Nepal OPD: Antenatal care; Vitamin D deficiency.

drugs.adult_dose: 60,000 IU weekly x8 weeks then maintenance
drugs.rag_text: Vitamin D deficiency common in Nepal despite sun — pollution and indoor lifestyle in cities. Loading dose then maintenance.
Tranexamic acid reduces menstrual blood loss. WHO recommends in trauma hemorrhage. Thrombosis risk if misused. Nepal OPD: Menorrhagia.

drugs.adult_dose: 600mcg sublingual PPH; 800mcg medical abortion per protocol
drugs.rag_text: Misoprostol critical for PPH prevention in Nepal maternal health programs. Heat-stable. Store away from moisture. Nepal OPD: Postpartum hemorrhage.

drugs.adult_dose: 10 IU IM postpartum; infusion per protocol
drugs.rag_text: Oxytocin first-line uterotonic. Cold chain required. Active management of third stage of labor standard in Nepal birthing centers. Nepal OPD: Postpartum hemorrhage.
Magnesium sulfate saves lives in eclampsia. Monitor reflexes, RR, urine output. Antidote: calcium gluconate 1g IV. Nepal OPD: Eclampsia; Pre-eclampsia.
IM adrenaline first-line anaphylaxis. Snakebite anaphylaxis to antivenom — have adrenaline ready. Expiry monitoring critical. Nepal OPD: Anaphylaxis; Snakebite envenomation.
Atropine for symptomatic bradycardia and OP poisoning in agricultural Nepal. Tachycardia and dry mouth at overdose. Nepal OPD: Organophosphate poisoning.

drugs.adult_dose: 5–10mg IV slow for seizures; 2–10mg PO BD PRN anxiety
drugs.rag_text: Diazepam first-line benzodiazepine for seizures in resource-limited settings. Respiratory depression — have bag-mask ready. Dependence with chronic use. Nepal OPD: Anxiety disorder; Epilepsy; Low back pain; Status epilepticus.

contraindications: No absolute — treat envenomation not bite alone
drugs.adult_dose: 10 vials IV diluted in 500ml NS; repeat as per WHO protocol
drugs.pediatric_dose: Same dose as adult — venom amount not body weight
drugs.rag_text: Nepal has high snakebite burden — krait, cobra, viper. WHO 20-minute whole blood clotting test. Adrenaline premedication if high anaphylaxis risk. Do not cut or suck wound. Nepal OPD: Snakebite envenomation.

Cetirizine non-sedating antihistamine for allergic conditions. Less sedating than chlorpheniramine. Dose reduce in renal impairment. Nepal OPD: Allergic rhinitis; Upper respiratory infection; Urticaria.
Chlorpheniramine sedating antihistamine widely available in Nepal. Warn about drowsiness — avoid driving/machinery. Nepal OPD: Urticaria.

drugs.pediatric_dose: Avoid routine use in young children
drugs.rag_text: Domperidone for nausea in Nepal OPD. QT risk — avoid with macrolides/fluoroquinolones. Prefer ORS for gastroenteritis first.
Pantoprazole PPI common in Nepal hospitals. Prefer short courses. Co-prescribe with NSAID if GI bleed risk high.
Doxycycline important for scrub typhus in Nepal hills/terai. Photosensitivity counsel. Not in pregnancy or young children.

Gentamicin injectable for severe infection in Nepal hospitals. Nephro/ototoxicity — check renal function. Often paired with penicillin/ampicillin in neonatal protocols. Nepal OPD: GERD dyspepsia; Peptic ulcer bleeding risk.

drugs.adult_dose: 100–200mg IV for emergency; taper per indication
drugs.rag_text: Hydrocortisone for adrenal crisis and anaphylaxis adjunct after adrenaline. Not a substitute for IM adrenaline in anaphylaxis. Nepal OPD: Leptospirosis; Pelvic inflammatory disease; Scrub typhus.

contraindications: Fluid overload / severe heart failure caution
drugs.rag_text: Normal saline workhorse IV fluid in Nepal facilities. For dengue plasma leakage prefer crystalloid carefully; avoid overload. Nepal OPD: Neonatal danger signs.
Ringer's lactate preferred for cholera/severe dehydration Plan C in WHO IMCI. Monitor for overload. Nepal OPD: Anaphylaxis.
Acetazolamide for AMS prophylaxis in Nepal trekkers. Start 24h before ascent. Tingling fingers common. Sulfa cross-reactivity possible. Nepal OPD: Altitude illness; Cholera; Heat exhaustion.
Nitrofurantoin first-line for uncomplicated cystitis when available in Nepal. Avoid if eGFR low. Take with food. Nepal OPD: UTI uncomplicated.
Ampicillin with gentamicin for neonatal sepsis per IMCI/Nepal protocols. Penicillin allergy assessment required. Nepal OPD: Neonatal danger signs; UTI pregnancy.
Levothyroxine for hypothyroidism common in iodine-deficient regions. Take empty stomach. Increase dose in pregnancy. Nepal OPD: Hypothyroidism.
Colchicine for acute gout when NSAIDs contraindicated. Diarrhea common. Drug interactions with macrolides and statins. Nepal OPD: Gout acute; Gout allopurinol.

drugs.adult_dose: Apply neck-down overnight; repeat at 7 days
drugs.rag_text: Permethrin first-line scabies treatment in Nepal. Treat contacts simultaneously. Wash bedding. Nepal OPD: Scabies; Scabies ivermectin.
Clotrimazole topical for dermatophyte infections common in humid Terai. Continue 1 week after clearance. Nepal OPD: Fungal skin infection.
Cephalexin oral cephalosporin for mild cellulitis when IV not needed. Penicillin cross-allergy ~1%. Nepal OPD: Cellulitis.

contraindications: History of bone marrow suppression with systemic use
drugs.adult_dose: 1 drop q2h while awake x2 days then q4h x5 days
drugs.rag_text: Chloramphenicol eye drops for bacterial conjunctivitis — topical only. Avoid systemic chloramphenicol except when no alternative. Nepal OPD: Conjunctivitis bacterial.
Fluoxetine SSRI per WHO mhGAP for moderate-severe depression. Slow onset 4–6 weeks. Monitor suicidality early. Nepal OPD: Depression SSRI; Depression mhGAP.
Acyclovir reduces zoster duration if started within 72h of rash. Adjust dose in renal impairment. Nepal OPD: Herpes zoster.
Vitamin A reduces measles mortality per WHO. Nepal supplementation programs for under-5 children. Nepal OPD: Measles.

drugs.adult_dose: IM deltoid days 0,3,7,14,28 (+ RIG day 0 if category III)
drugs.rag_text: Rabies PEP essential in Nepal dog bite burden. Wash wound 15 min soap water first. Complete full course. Nepal OPD: Animal bite non-snake; Rabies PEP.

drugs.adult_dose: 0.5ml IM; booster q10y or per wound protocol
drugs.rag_text: Tetanus toxoid for wound prophylaxis. Nepal EPI includes pentavalent/DPT for children. Nepal OPD: Tetanus prophylaxis.

drugs.adult_dose: 1–2g IV over 15–30 min; repeat per protocol
drugs.rag_text: Pralidoxime adjunct to atropine in OP poisoning — agricultural Nepal exposure. Early administration more effective. Nepal OPD: Organophosphate poisoning.

drugs.adult_dose: IV 21h protocol or 150mg/kg oral loading per nomogram
drugs.rag_text: NAC within 8h of paracetamol overdose prevents hepatotoxicity. Use Rumack-Matthew nomogram. Nepal OPD: Paracetamol overdose.
Combined OCP widely used in Nepal family planning clinics. Counsel missed pill rules and VTE risk factors. Nepal OPD: Family planning OCP.
Levonorgestrel EC — single dose as soon as possible after unprotected intercourse. Not for regular contraception. Nepal OPD: Emergency contraception.
Tamsulosin for BPH LUTS. First-dose syncope — take at bedtime initially. Not for use in women. Nepal OPD: Benign prostatic hyperplasia.

contraindications: Women of childbearing age handling crushed tabs
drugs.rag_text: Finasteride shrinks prostate over months. Teratogenic — women should not handle broken tablets. Nepal OPD: Benign prostatic hyperplasia.
Liposomal amphotericin for kala-azar in Nepal Terai endemic districts. Refer to treatment centers. Nepal OPD: Kala-azar visceral leishmaniasis.
DEC for filariasis MDA in endemic Nepal districts. MDA programs coordinated nationally. Nepal OPD: Filariasis.
Dapsone part of WHO leprosy MDT with rifampicin and clofazimine. G6PD test before starting. Nepal OPD: Leprosy.
Atorvastatin for dyslipidemia in high CVD risk patients. Monitor LFTs. Myopathy rare — counsel muscle pain. Nepal OPD: Dyslipidemia; Hyperlipidemia statin therapy; Stable angina.
Lactulose osmotic laxative safe in pregnancy. Bloating initially — titrate dose. Nepal OPD: Constipation.
Bisacodyl stimulant laxative for short-term constipation. Avoid long-term use. Nepal OPD: Constipation.

drugs.adult_dose: 4mg then 2mg after each loose stool; max 16mg/day
drugs.rag_text: Loperamide for non-dysenteric travelers diarrhea in adults. NOT for bloody diarrhea or children — ORS first. Nepal OPD: Travelers diarrhea adult.

drugs.adult_dose: Instill BD x3–5 days before syringing
drugs.rag_text: Cerumenolytic softens wax before irrigation. Exclude perforated TM first. Nepal OPD: Impacted ear wax.
IV artesunate first-line severe malaria per WHO. Refer unstable patients. Follow with ACT course. Nepal OPD: Severe malaria.
Primaquine for vivax radical cure — mandatory G6PD test first. Hemolysis risk if G6PD deficient. Nepal OPD: P vivax radical cure.
NRT gum adjunct to counseling for tobacco cessation. Cheek park technique — do not swallow. Nepal OPD: Tobacco cessation.
Mebendazole alternative to albendazole for pinworm. Treat household contacts. Nepal OPD: Worm infestation child.

drugs.adult_dose: Iodized salt primary prevention; KI per national programs
drugs.rag_text: Iodized salt is primary goiter prevention in Nepal. Universal salt iodization program. Nepal OPD: Iodine deficiency goiter.
Timolol beta-blocker eye drops reduce IOP. Systemic absorption — avoid in asthma. Nepal OPD: Glaucoma initial.
Tramadol step-2 analgesic when paracetamol insufficient. Lower seizure threshold — avoid with SSRIs/tramadol duplication. Nepal OPD: Acute pain ladder.

Lisinopril ACE inhibitor — common in Nepal OPD and pharmacies. Once daily. Contraindicated in pregnancy. Monitor K+ and creatinine. NNLEM core ACE-I class includes enalapril; lisinopril widely substituted. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Hypertension; Hypertension ACE inhibitor.
Ramipril ACE inhibitor for hypertension and heart failure with cardioprotection. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Acute pain ladder.
Captopril short-acting ACE-I for hypertension and heart failure. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Hydrochlorothiazide thiazide — WHO PEN first-line with ACE-I/CCB for hypertension. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Hypertension; Hypertension ACE inhibitor; Resistant hypertension.
Chlorthalidone long-acting thiazide-like diuretic for hypertension. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Spironolactone for resistant HTN and HFrEF. Hyperkalemia risk with ACE-I/ARB. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Heart failure reduced EF; Resistant hypertension.
Bisoprolol for heart failure and hypertension. Do not stop abruptly. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Heart failure reduced EF.
Metoprolol for post-MI, AF rate control, hypertension. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Atrial fibrillation.
Propranolol for migraine prophylaxis, thyrotoxicosis, tremor. Avoid in asthma. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Carvedilol for heart failure and hypertension. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Telmisartan ARB when ACE-I not tolerated. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Olmesartan ARB for hypertension. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Nifedipine ER for hypertension and angina. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Gestational hypertension.
Simvastatin for hyperlipidemia and CVD prevention — NNLEM statin class. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Hyperlipidemia statin therapy.
Rosuvastatin potent statin when LDL target not met. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Hyperlipidemia statin therapy.
Pravastatin with fewer CYP interactions. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Long-acting nitrate for stable angina prophylaxis. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Stable angina.
GTN SL for acute angina. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Stable angina.
Digoxin for AF rate control and selected heart failure. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Atrial fibrillation.
Enoxaparin for DVT/PE and ACS inpatient. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Apixaban DOAC for AF where available. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Atrial fibrillation.
Clarithromycin for H. pylori and atypical pneumonia. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: H pylori clarithromycin.
Cefixime oral cephalosporin for typhoid and UTI. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Typhoid cefixime.
Cefpodoxime for respiratory and skin infections. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Levofloxacin — reserve; tendon and QT risks. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Co-trimoxazole for UTI and selected infections. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Fluconazole for candidiasis. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Vulvovaginal candidiasis.

drugs.adult_dose: 500mg pessary or cream BD x3 days
drugs.rag_text: Clotrimazole for vulvovaginal candidiasis. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Vulvovaginal candidiasis.
Valproate broad-spectrum antiepileptic; teratogenic. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Epilepsy valproate.
Phenytoin for epilepsy; narrow therapeutic index. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Epilepsy valproate.
Lamotrigine for epilepsy; SJS if titrated too fast. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Sertraline SSRI per mhGAP. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Depression SSRI.
Amitriptyline for neuropathic pain and depression. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Diabetic neuropathy.
Haloperidol for acute psychosis and agitation. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Acute psychosis.
Risperidone for psychosis. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Acute psychosis.
Montelukast asthma controller add-on. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Asthma montelukast.
Ipratropium for COPD with salbutamol. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: COPD bronchodilator.
Budesonide ICS for asthma. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Asthma montelukast.
Salmeterol LABA — always with ICS in asthma. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Gliclazide sulfonylurea for T2DM. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Glimepiride once-daily sulfonylurea. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Regular insulin short-acting for DKA and meal coverage. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Insulin glargine basal insulin. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Insulin therapy T2DM.
Allopurinol urate-lowering for gout prophylaxis. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Gout allopurinol.
Diclofenac NSAID widely used in Nepal — GI/CV risk. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Naproxen NSAID; avoid in dengue. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Pregabalin for neuropathic pain. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Diabetic neuropathy.
B12 deficiency with metformin and vegetarian diets. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Potassium replacement with diuretics. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Hydralazine for hypertension in pregnancy. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Methyldopa first-line HTN in pregnancy. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Gestational hypertension.
Labetalol for HTN in pregnancy. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Gestational hypertension.
Ivermectin for scabies and MDA programs. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD. Nepal OPD: Scabies ivermectin.
Praziquantel for tapeworm. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
Clindamycin for anaerobic and skin infections. NNLEM 2021 / WHO SEARO Nepal OPD.
